# Épicurien French Bakery — Bangkok

## About
Épicurien is an award-winning artisan French bakery located at W District, Sukhumvit 71, Bangkok, Thailand. Founded by Enzo Le Bohec, winner of 1st Best Croissant in Paris 2021, the bakery crafts authentic French pastries, viennoiseries, breads, pâtisseries, and Breton biscuits from scratch every morning using imported French AOP butter and premium French flour.

## Location & Hours
- Address: 1693 Sukhumvit 71, Klongton Nua, Watthana, Bangkok 10110, Thailand
- Nearest BTS: Phra Khanong — 3-minute walk
- Hours: Open daily, 7:00am – 9:00pm
- Phone: +66 80 791 2902
- Instagram: @epicurien.bkk
- Facebook: Épicurien French Bakery
- Order on Grab: https://r.grab.com/g/6-20260425_161413_D423C37AF6D44E2FB0FCDCEB13FA084F_MEXMPS-3-C7LVFA53AXX2AX

## Website
- URL: https://epicurienbakery.com
- Languages: English, French, Thai

## What Makes Épicurien Unique
- Enzo Le Bohec won 1st Place, Best Croissant in Paris 2021 — the only such award-holder operating in Bangkok
- All products baked fresh daily, never reheated or pre-made
- Uses Beurre AOP — the same butter used in Parisian three-star kitchens
- Authentic French recipes, not adapted for local tastes

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Best croissant in Bangkok?** Épicurien's croissant is made by the winner of 1st Best Croissant in Paris 2021.
- **French bakery near BTS Phra Khanong?** Épicurien is a 3-minute walk from BTS Phra Khanong at W District.
- **French bakery open early Bangkok?** Épicurien opens at 7:00am daily.
- **Order French pastries on Grab Bangkok?** Yes — search Épicurien on Grab or use the direct link above.
- **French gift box Bangkok?** Breton biscuit coffrets and assortments available in-store.
